knowledge:
- key_parameters: bcStart=The starting base position of the cell barcode in Read 1 ;; bcStop=The ending base position of the cell barcode in Read 1 ;; umiStart=The starting base position of the UMI sequence in Read 1 ;; umiStop=The ending base position of the UMI sequence in Read 1 ;; bcEdit=The edit distance threshold allowed for cell barcode correction ;; umiEdit=The edit distance threshold allowed for UMI correction ;; keep=The length to which reads will be trimmed ;; minQual=The minimum Phred score quality threshold for barcode and UMI nucleotides (reads with lower quality are excluded) ;; cellPerWell=A vector indicating the number of sorted cells in each well, used to color QC plots and identify empty wells or bulk controls ;; cores=The number of cores to use for parallel processing
- alternatives: Rsubread::buildindex is used for reference genome indexing ;; HTSeq Python package's union counting mode is implemented internally for feature counting ;; GenomicAlignments::readGAlignments is used to read BAM files into R for visualization ;; 10X Cell Ranger pipeline is the standard source of BAM files analyzed by tenxBamqc
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing single-cell RNA-seq data generated specifically using CEL-Seq or CEL-Seq2 protocols, or when you need to perform quality assessment on 10X Genomics BAM files.
- pitfalls: Requires an Rsubread index and a GTF/TxDb object for the reference genome ;; By default, reads with any nucleotide in the barcode or UMI sequences having a Phred score lower than 10 are excluded ;; Ensure correct coordinates for barcode and UMI in Read 1 (bcStart, bcStop, umiStart, umiStop) to avoid incorrect demultiplexing ;; The cellPerWell vector length must match the number of cell barcodes in the barcode list

workflows.name: cel_seq_pipeline_wrapper
workflows.intent: Run the all-in-one scruff wrapper to demultiplex, align, and count UMIs for CEL-Seq/CEL-Seq2 data.
input: read1Path.fastq.gz (Read 1 FASTQ file containing cell barcode and UMI)
read2Path.fastq.gz (Read 2 FASTQ file containing transcript sequence)
workflows.stages: 1. Build Rsubread index ;; 2. Run all-in-one scruff pipeline ;; 3. Plot QC metrics
workflows.code:
Rsubread::buildindex(basename = indexBase, reference = fasta, indexSplit = FALSE)
sce <- scruff(project = "example", experiment = c("1h1"), lane = c("L001"), read1Path = c(v1h1R1), read2Path = c(v1h1R2), bc = barcodeExample, index = indexBase, unique = FALSE, nBestLocations = 1, reference = gtf, bcStart = 1, bcStop = 8, bcEdit = 1, umiStart = 9, umiStop = 12, umiEdit = 1, keep = 75, cellPerWell = c(rep(1, 46), 0, 0), cores = 2, verbose = TRUE)
qc <- qcplots(sceExample)

workflows.name: cel_seq_pipeline_stepwise
workflows.intent: Run stepwise demultiplexing, alignment, and UMI counting for CEL-Seq/CEL-Seq2 data.
input: read1Path.fastq.gz (Read 1 FASTQ file containing cell barcode and UMI)
read2Path.fastq.gz (Read 2 FASTQ file containing transcript sequence)
workflows.stages: 1. Demultiplex reads using demultiplex ;; 2. Build Rsubread index ;; 3. Align reads using alignRsubread ;; 4. Count UMIs using countUMI ;; 5. Plot QC metrics
workflows.code:
de <- demultiplex(project = "example", experiment = c("1h1"), lane = c("L001"), read1Path = c(v1h1R1), read2Path = c(v1h1R2), barcodeExample, bcStart = 1, bcStop = 8, bcEdit = 1, umiStart = 9, umiStop = 12, keep = 75, minQual = 10, yieldReads = 1e+06, verbose = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE, cores = 2)
Rsubread::buildindex(basename = indexBase, reference = fasta, indexSplit = FALSE)
al <- alignRsubread(de, indexBase, unique = FALSE, nBestLocations = 1, format = "BAM", overwrite = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, cores = 2)
sce <- countUMI(al, gtf, umiEdit = 1, format = "BAM", cellPerWell = c(rep(1, 46), 0, 0), verbose = TRUE, cores = 2)
qc <- qcplots(sceExample)

workflows.name: tenx_bam_qc
workflows.intent: Collect and visualize QC metrics from 10X Cell Ranger BAM files.
input: cell_ranger_output.bam (BAM file generated by 10X Cell Ranger pipeline)
workflows.stages: 1. Run tenxBamqc to collect QC metrics ;; 2. Plot QC metrics using qcplots
workflows.code:
sce <- tenxBamqc(bam = bamfile10x, experiment = "Neurons_Sample_01", filter = filteredBc)
g <- qcplots(sce)

workflows.name: read_mapping_visualization
workflows.intent: Visualize read alignment locations and gene models at specified genomic coordinates.
input: alignments.bam (BAM file loaded as a GAlignments object)
workflows.stages: 1. Visualize reads using rview ;; 2. Visualize gene models using gview ;; 3. Combine plots using patchwork
workflows.code:
g1 <- rview(bamExample, chr = "MT", start = start, end = end) + ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(start, end))
g2 <- gview(gtf, chr = "MT", start = start, end = end) + ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(start, end))
g <- (g1 + ggplot2::theme(axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(), plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0, b = 0))) / (g2 + ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0, b = 0))) / patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(4, 1))
